name: audit-fixture-bundle-deps
_comment: The `npm` package itself is the canonical real-world bundleDependencies user — npm@11 ships 65 bundled deps inside its published tarball's `node_modules/` directory. lpm has zero explicit bundleDependencies handling (verified via `grep bundleDep crates/`), so the test verifies the implicit invariant: the extractor preserves the tarball-internal `node_modules/` subtree as part of the package source, and the linker doesn't strip or shadow it. Risk: hoisted layout might overwrite vendored deps if the same package name appears at top level via another transitive path. lodash is added as a direct dep (resolver-fetched, sits next to npm in the top-level layout). npm itself is in devDependencies because npm@8+ intentionally throws when `require('npm')` runs at module load (programmatic API removed) — the harness's per-direct-dep require check would trip on that even though the bundleDeps invariant is intact. Smoke verifies the layout directly, not via require().
